```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(broom)
library(knitr)
library(readr)
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}

cars_accidents_data = read.csv("data/CarsAccidentsData.csv")
cars_data = read.csv("data/CarsDatanew.csv")

alert_systems_cols = c("BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION","FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING", "LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING")
active_systems_cols = c("CRASH_IMMINENT_BRAKE", "DYNAMIC_BRAKE_SUPPORT", "NHTSA_ESC")


```


# פה מכינים את הדאטה של המכוניות כדי לנרמל למודלים

```{r}

# פה מפלטרים את הדאטה לפי הפילטור למטה


all_systems <- c(alert_systems_cols, active_systems_cols)

convert_values <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ 0,
    tolower(x) %in% c("standard", "standart", "std", "available") ~ 1,
    tolower(x) %in% c("optional", "option") ~ 2,
    tolower(x) %in% c("none", "n/a", "not available", "") ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ 0
  )
}

set.seed(123)

cars_clean_data <- cars_data %>%
  filter(MODEL_YR >= 2011 & MODEL_YR <= 2023) %>%
  mutate_at(all_systems, convert_values) %>%
  mutate_at(all_systems, ~ ifelse(. == 2, sample(c(0, 1), size = length(.), replace = TRUE), .)) %>%
  distinct(MAKE, MODEL, MODEL_YR, .keep_all = TRUE)




```


```{r}
# מראה לי את האחוז של כמות המערכות

systems_by_count <- cars_clean_data %>%
  mutate(system_count = rowSums(.[, all_systems] == 1)) %>%
  group_by(system_count) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percent = round(100 * Count / nrow(.), 2) / 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(system_count)

systems_by_count
```


```{r}

# ליצור טבלה את אחוז כול הקומבינציות של המערכות


combo_data <- cars_clean_data[, all_systems]
combo_data <- as.data.frame(lapply(combo_data, function(x) as.integer(x == 1)))


combo_data$combo_string <- apply(combo_data, 1, paste0, collapse = "")


combo_summary <- combo_data %>%
  group_by(combo_string) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percent = round(100 * Count / nrow(combo_data), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Count))

combo_split <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(combo_summary$combo_string, split = ""))
combo_split <- as.data.frame(combo_split)
colnames(combo_split) <- all_systems

car_safey_combinations <- cbind(combo_split, combo_summary[, c("Count", "Percent")])
car_safey_combinations <- car_safey_combinations %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(all_systems), as.integer))

car_safey_combinations
```


```{r}

# אחוז הרכבים הכוללים את סוגי המערכות השונות: מערכות התראה/ מערכות אקטיביות או את שתיהן

GroupSummary <- cars_clean_data %>%
  mutate(
    has_alert = rowSums(.[, alert_systems_cols] == 1) > 0,
    has_active = rowSums(.[, active_systems_cols] == 1) > 0,
    group = case_when(
      has_alert & has_active ~ "Both",
      has_alert & !has_active ~ "Alerts Only",
      !has_alert & has_active ~ "Active Only",
      TRUE ~ "None"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percent = round(100 * Count / nrow(cars_clean_data), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Percent))

print(GroupSummary)
```
```{r}


# שלב 4: קומבינציות
combo_data <- cars_clean_data[, alert_systems_cols]
combo_data[] <- lapply(combo_data, function(x) as.integer(x == 1))
combo_data$combo_string <- apply(combo_data, 1, paste0, collapse = "")

# שלב 5: טבלת סיכום
combo_summary <- combo_data %>%
  group_by(combo_string) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percent = round(100 * Count / nrow(combo_data), 2) / 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Count))

# שלב 6: פיצול מחרוזת קומבינציה חזרה לעמודות
alert_system_group <- combo_summary %>%
  mutate(
    BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION = as.integer(substr(combo_string, 1, 1)),
    FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING = as.integer(substr(combo_string, 2, 2)),
    LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING = as.integer(substr(combo_string, 3, 3)),
    combo_alert_systems = paste0(BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION, FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING, LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING)
  )

# שלב 7: סידור מחדש של העמודות
alert_system_group <- alert_system_group[, c("BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION", "FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING", "LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING",  "combo_alert_systems", "Count", "Percent")]

```



# פה צריך להיגמר כול הנרמולים למינהם

```{r}

set.seed(123) 

cars_accidents_data = cars_accidents_data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(alert_systems_cols), ~ ifelse(.x == 2, sample(c(0, 1), size = length(.x), replace = TRUE), .x)))

cars_accidents_data = cars_accidents_data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(active_systems_cols), ~ ifelse(.x == 2, sample(c(0, 1), size = length(.x), replace = TRUE), .x)))

cars_accidents_data = cars_accidents_data %>% 
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("AUTO_CRASH_NOTIFICATION", "ARS")))

cars_accidents_data$notification_count = rowSums(cars_accidents_data[, alert_systems_cols] == 1)
```


```{r}

cars_accidents_data <- cars_accidents_data %>%
  filter(
    DR_DRINK == 0,                              
    VSURCONDNAME == "Dry",                      
    !grepl("(?i)Yes", SPEEDRELNAME),            
    !grepl("(?i)Unknown", SPEEDRELNAME),        
    L_STATUSNAME == "Valid",
    IS_DRIVER_PRESENT == 1
  )
```


```{r}


# Step 2: Summarize accidents by safety_count (excluding safety_count == 6)
accidents_by_safety_count <- cars_accidents_data %>%
  group_by(SAFETY_COUNT) %>%
  summarise(num_accidents = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(SAFETY_COUNT %in% 1:5) %>%  
  mutate(
    group_size = systems_by_count$Count[as.character(SAFETY_COUNT)],
    group_prob = systems_by_count$Percent[as.character(SAFETY_COUNT)], # שב על זה אחכ ותתקן, לא שכוח שזה כבר מוכפל ב100 וצריך לחלק
    accidents_per_vehicle = num_accidents / group_size,
    accidents_per_percent = num_accidents / group_prob
  )

# Step 3: Plot actual number of accidents (not normalized)
ggplot(accidents_by_safety_count, aes(x = factor(SAFETY_COUNT), y = num_accidents)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Accidents by Number of Safety Systems",
    x = "Number of Safety Systems",
    y = "Number of Accidents"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```


```{r}
# שלב 1: יצירת מזהים
car_safey_combinations <- car_safey_combinations %>%
  mutate(
    combo_alerts = paste0(FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING, LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING, BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION),
    combo_actives = paste0(CRASH_IMMINENT_BRAKE, DYNAMIC_BRAKE_SUPPORT, NHTSA_ESC),
    combo_full = paste0(combo_alerts, "_", combo_actives),
    alert_sum = FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING + LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING + BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION,
    active_sum = CRASH_IMMINENT_BRAKE + DYNAMIC_BRAKE_SUPPORT + NHTSA_ESC
  )

# שלב 2: בסיס — אותן התראות בדיוק, בלי אקטיביות
base <- car_safey_combinations %>%
  filter(alert_sum > 0, active_sum == 0) %>%
  dplyr::select(combo_alerts, base_combo = combo_full, base_count = Count)

# שלב 3: תוספת — אותן התראות בדיוק, עם לפחות אקטיבית אחת
added <- car_safey_combinations %>%
  filter(alert_sum > 0, active_sum >= 1) %>%
  dplyr::select(combo_alerts, comparison_combo = combo_full, comparison_count = Count)

# שלב 4: השוואה בין בסיס לתוספת
comparisons <- inner_join(base, added, by = "combo_alerts") %>%
  mutate(
    diff = comparison_count - base_count,
    label = paste(base_combo, "→", comparison_combo)
  )

# שלב 5: ציור הגרף
ggplot(comparisons, aes(x = label, y = diff)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkred") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Change in Crash Count After Adding Active Systems (Same Alert Combo)",
    x = "From → To (Same Alerts)",
    y = "Difference in Crash Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# שלב 4: השוואה בין בסיס לתוספת
comparisons <- inner_join(base, added, by = "combo_alerts") %>%
  mutate(
    diff = comparison_count - base_count,
    label = paste(base_combo, "→", comparison_combo)
  )

# ✳️ הדפסה של כל ההשוואות בטקסט
cat("🔍 כל ההשוואות בין קומבינציות:\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(comparisons))) {
  cat(paste0("• ", comparisons$base_combo[i], " → ", comparisons$comparison_combo[i], "\n"))
}
```


```{r}

# שלב 1: יצירת מזהים לכל קומבינציה
car_safey_combinations <- car_safey_combinations %>%
  mutate(
    combo_alerts = paste0(FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING, LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING, BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION),
    combo_actives = paste0(CRASH_IMMINENT_BRAKE, DYNAMIC_BRAKE_SUPPORT, NHTSA_ESC),
    combo_full = paste0(combo_alerts, "_", combo_actives),
    alert_sum = FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING + LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING + BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION,
    active_sum = CRASH_IMMINENT_BRAKE + DYNAMIC_BRAKE_SUPPORT + NHTSA_ESC
  )

# שלב 2: בסיס — אותן התראות בדיוק, ללא מערכות אקטיביות
base <- car_safey_combinations %>%
  filter(alert_sum > 0, active_sum == 0) %>%
  dplyr::select(combo_alerts, base_combo = combo_full, base_count = Count)

# שלב 3: תוספת — אותן התראות בדיוק, עם לפחות מערכת אקטיבית אחת
added <- car_safey_combinations %>%
  filter(alert_sum > 0, active_sum >= 1) %>%
  dplyr::select(combo_alerts, comparison_combo = combo_full, comparison_count = Count)

# שלב 4: חיבור בין בסיס לתוספת לפי combo_alerts בלבד
comparisons <- inner_join(base, added, by = "combo_alerts") %>%
  mutate(
    diff = comparison_count - base_count,
    label = paste(base_combo, "→", comparison_combo)
  )

# שלב 5: סינון — רק 5 הקומבינציות שבהן מספר התאונות עלה הכי הרבה (diff שלילי הכי חזק)
top5_negative <- comparisons %>%
  arrange(diff) %>%
  head(5)

# שלב 6: ציור הגרף
ggplot(top5_negative, aes(x = label, y = diff)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkred") +
  geom_text(aes(label = diff), vjust = -0.5, color = "black", size = 4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Top 5 Increases in Crash Count After Adding Active Systems",
    x = "From → To (Same Alerts)",
    y = "Difference in Crash Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```


```{r}


cars_accidents_data_combo_Group <- cars_accidents_data %>%
  mutate(
    has_alert = rowSums(across(all_of(alert_systems_cols)) == 1) > 0,
    has_active = rowSums(across(all_of(active_systems_cols)) == 1) > 0,
    group = case_when(
      has_alert & has_active ~ "Both",
      has_alert & !has_active ~ "Alerts Only",
      !has_alert & has_active ~ "Active Only",
      TRUE ~ "None"
    ),
    is_severe = DEFORMEDNAME %in% c("Disabling Damage", "Functional Damage")
  ) %>%
  filter(group != "None", is_severe)

# סיכום מספר תאונות חמורות לפי קבוצה
accident_summary <- cars_accidents_data_combo_Group %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(SevereCrashCount = n(), .groups = "drop")

# שילוב עם אחוזי האוכלוסייה האמיתיים
accident_summary <- accident_summary %>%
  inner_join(GroupSummary, by = "group") %>%
  mutate(
    PopulationShare = Percent / 100,
    NormalizedRate = SevereCrashCount / PopulationShare
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(NormalizedRate))

ggplot(accident_summary, aes(x = fct_reorder(group, NormalizedRate), y = NormalizedRate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Normalized Severe Crash Rate by System Group (Excluding 'None')",
    x = "System Group",
    y = "Severe Crashes / Population Share"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


```



```{r}

# שיוך קבוצה + תאונה קשה
cars_accidents_data_grouped <- cars_accidents_data %>%
  mutate(
    has_alert = rowSums(across(all_of(alert_systems_cols)) == 1) > 0,
    has_active = rowSums(across(all_of(active_systems_cols)) == 1) > 0,
    group = case_when(
      has_alert & has_active ~ "Both",
      has_alert & !has_active ~ "Alerts Only",
      !has_alert & has_active ~ "Active Only",
      TRUE ~ "None"
    ),
    severe = DEFORMEDNAME %in% c("Disabling Damage", "Functional Damage")
  ) %>%
  left_join(GroupSummary, by = "group") %>%  # מצרף את העמודה Percent
  mutate(
    weight = 1 / (Percent / 100)  # משקל הפוך לשיעור באוכלוסייה
  )

# הפיכת group לפקטור עם 'None' כבסיס להשוואה
cars_accidents_data_grouped$group <- relevel(factor(cars_accidents_data_grouped$group), ref = "None")

# מודל רגרסיה לוגיסטית עם משקולות מנורמלות
model <- glm(severe ~ group, data = cars_accidents_data_grouped,
             weights = weight, family = "binomial")

# טבלת מקדמים (רק Alerts Only ו-Active Only)
library(broom)
coef_df <- tidy(model) %>%
  filter(term %in% c("groupAlerts Only", "groupActive Only")) %>%
  mutate(
    Predictor = case_when(
      term == "groupAlerts Only" ~ "Alerts Only vs None",
      term == "groupActive Only" ~ "Active Only vs None"
    ),
    ymin = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
    ymax = estimate + 1.96 * std.error
  )

# ציור גרף של מקדמי השוואה
ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = Predictor, y = estimate)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Effect of Warning and Active Systems vs None (Normalized)",
    x = "Group Comparison",
    y = "Log Odds Estimate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}

# שיוך קבוצה + תאונה קשה + נרמול
cars_accidents_data_grouped <- cars_accidents_data %>%
  mutate(
    has_alert = rowSums(across(all_of(alert_systems)) == 1) > 0,
    has_active = rowSums(across(all_of(active_systems)) == 1) > 0,
    group = case_when(
      has_alert & has_active ~ "Both",
      has_alert & !has_active ~ "Alerts Only",
      !has_alert & has_active ~ "Active Only",
      TRUE ~ "None"
    ),
    severe = DEFORMEDNAME %in% c("Disabling Damage", "Functional Damage")
  ) %>%
  left_join(GroupSummary, by = "group") %>%
  mutate(
    weight = 1 / (Percent / 100)
  )

### מודל 1: Both vs Alerts Only
data_both_alerts <- cars_accidents_data_grouped %>%
  filter(group %in% c("Both", "Alerts Only")) %>%
  mutate(is_both = ifelse(group == "Both", 1, 0))

model_both_vs_alerts <- glm(severe ~ is_both, data = data_both_alerts,
                            weights = weight, family = "binomial")

coef_both_vs_alerts <- tidy(model_both_vs_alerts) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(Predictor = "Both vs Alerts Only")

### מודל 2: Both vs Active Only
data_both_active <- cars_accidents_data_grouped %>%
  filter(group %in% c("Both", "Active Only")) %>%
  mutate(is_both = ifelse(group == "Both", 1, 0))

model_both_vs_active <- glm(severe ~ is_both, data = data_both_active,
                            weights = weight, family = "binomial")

coef_both_vs_active <- tidy(model_both_vs_active) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(Predictor = "Both vs Active Only")

# שילוב שני המודלים לגרף אחד
coefs_combined <- bind_rows(coef_both_vs_alerts, coef_both_vs_active) %>%
  mutate(
    ymin = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
    ymax = estimate + 1.96 * std.error
  )

# ציור גרף
ggplot(coefs_combined, aes(x = Predictor, y = estimate)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Effect of Both Systems vs Each Alone (Normalized)",
    x = "Group Comparison",
    y = "Log Odds Estimate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# modeling

```{r}

cars_accidents_data$combo_alert_systems = apply(cars_accidents_data[, alert_systems_cols], 1, paste0, collapse = "")

valid_combos = c("001", "010", "100", "110", "101", "011")

cars_accidents_data = cars_accidents_data %>%
  filter(DEFORMEDNAME == "Disabling Damage",
         TYPE_OF_COLLIOSION %in% c("Angle", "Front-to-Front", "Front-to-Rear","Rear-to-Side","Sideswipe - Same Direction", "Sideswipe - Opposite Direction")
         )


cars_accidents_data = cars_accidents_data %>%
  filter(combo_alert_systems %in% valid_combos)

alert_system_group = alert_system_group %>%
  filter(!alert_system_group$combo_alert_systems %in% c("000", "111"))


cars_accidents_data <- cars_accidents_data %>%
  left_join(
    alert_system_group %>% select(combo_alert_systems, Percent),
    by = "combo_alert_systems"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    weight_alert_system = 1 / Percent
  )


# שלב 5: מודלים עם interactions ו־weights
model_front = glm(grepl("Front", TYPE_OF_COLLIOSION) ~
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING + LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING + BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION +
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING +
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION +
                     LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING:BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION,
                   data = cars_accidents_data, family = "binomial", weights = weight_alert_system)

model_side = glm(grepl("Side", TYPE_OF_COLLIOSION) ~
                    FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING + LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING + BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION +
                    FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING +
                    FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION +
                    LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING:BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION,
                  data = cars_accidents_data, family = "binomial", weights = weight_alert_system)

model_angle = glm(grepl("Angle", TYPE_OF_COLLIOSION) ~
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING + LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING + BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION +
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING +
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION +
                     LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING:BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION,
                   data = cars_accidents_data, family = "binomial", weights = weight_alert_system)


```

```{r}
# שלב 6: חילוץ מקדמים
extract_coefs = function(model, crash_type) {
  tidy(model) %>%
    mutate(CrashType = crash_type)
}

coef_table = bind_rows(
  extract_coefs(model_front, "Front"),
  extract_coefs(model_side,  "Side"),
  extract_coefs(model_angle, "Angle")
) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    term = recode(term,
      "FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING" = "Front Warning",
      "LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING" = "Lane Warning",
      "BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION" = "Blind Spot",
      "FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING" = "Front + Lane",
      "FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION" = "Front + Blind",
      "LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING:BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION" = "Lane + Blind"
    ),
    lower = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
    upper = estimate + 1.96 * std.error
  )

significant = coef_table %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05)

kable(significant, digits = 3, caption = "Significant Effects (p < 0.05)")

```


```{r}
ggplot(coef_table, aes(x = term, y = estimate, color = CrashType)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  labs(
    title = "Coefficient Plot (Serious Crashes, Normalized)",
    x = "System or Combination",
    y = "Coefficient (Log-Odds)",
    color = "Crash Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
        DYNAMIC_BRAKE_SUPPORT,
        NHTSA_ESC,
        combo_all_systems,
        Percent
      ),
    by = c(
      "BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION",
      "FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING",
      "LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING",
      "CRASH_IMMINENT_BRAKE",
      "DYNAMIC_BRAKE_SUPPORT",
      "NHTSA_ESC"
    )
  )

cars_accidents_data = cars_accidents_data %>%
  rename(
    precent_all_systems = Percent
  ) %>%
   mutate(
    weight_all_systems = 1 / precent_all_systems
  )

cars_accidents_data
```


 
```{r}
model_front_extend = glm(grepl("Front", TYPE_OF_COLLIOSION) ~
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING:CRASH_IMMINENT_BRAKE + # 011100
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING:DYNAMIC_BRAKE_SUPPORT + # 011010
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION:CRASH_IMMINENT_BRAKE, # 110100
                   data = cars_accidents_data, family = "binomial", weights = weight_all_systems)

model_side_extend = glm(grepl("Side", TYPE_OF_COLLIOSION) ~
                    BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION:NHTSA_ESC + # 100001
                    FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING:NHTSA_ESC,# 011001
                  data = cars_accidents_data, family = "binomial", weights = weight_all_systems)

model_angle_extend = glm(grepl("Angle", TYPE_OF_COLLIOSION) ~
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:CRASH_IMMINENT_BRAKE + # 010100
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:DYNAMIC_BRAKE_SUPPORT + # 010010
                     FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING:CRASH_IMMINENT_BRAKE + # 011100
                     BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION:FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:NHTSA_ESC, # 110001
                   data = cars_accidents_data, family = "binomial", weights = weight_all_systems)
```

```{r}
# פונקציית חילוץ מקדמים ממודל
extract_coefs <- function(model, crash_type) {
  broom::tidy(model) %>%
    mutate(CrashType = crash_type)
}

# איחוד כל המודלים
coef_table <- bind_rows(
  extract_coefs(model_front_extend, "Front"),
  extract_coefs(model_side_extend, "Side"),
  extract_coefs(model_angle_extend, "Angle")
) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    term = recode(term,
      # Blind + Active
         "FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:CRASH_IMMINENT_BRAKE:LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING" = "Front + Lane + Imminent_Brake",
         "BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION:NHTSA_ESC" = "Blind + ESC",
         "FRNT_COLLISION_WARNING:BLIND_SPOT_DETECTION:NHTSA_ESC" = "Front + Blind + ESC",
      .default = term  # משאיר את כל היתר ללא שינוי
    ),
    lower = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
    upper = estimate + 1.96 * std.error
  )

# מסנן רק מקדמים מובהקים
significant <- coef_table %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05)

# הצגת טבלה
knitr::kable(significant, digits = 3, caption = "Significant Effects (p < 0.05)")
```



```{r}


# טבלת תוצאות
effects_df <- data.frame(
  Comparison = c("Front + Blind -> +ESC","Blind -> +ESC"),
  From_OR = exp(c(0.402, -0.150)),
  To_OR = exp(c(-0.845, -0.451)),
  CrashType = c("Angle",  "Side")
) %>%
  mutate(
    PercentChange = (From_OR - To_OR) / From_OR * 100
  )

colors = c("Side" = "indianred" ,  "Angle" = "steelblue")

# ציור גרף
ggplot(effects_df, aes(x = Comparison, y = PercentChange, fill = CrashType)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(PercentChange, 1), "%")),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(scale = 1),
    limits = c(0, 100)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Percent Reduction in Crash Odds After Adding Safety Systems",
    y = "Reduction",
    x = "System Addition",
    fill = "Crash Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )
```
